description_en: Lists RAM users that have not been imported into a specified instance
description_zh: 调用ListRamUsers获取未导入指定实例下的RAM用户列表
kebab_example: aliyun ccc list-ram-users --instance-id ccc-test --search-pattern agent --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListRamUsers

parameters.help_en: The keyword to use for a fuzzy search based on the RAM user's logon name or display name. This parameter is optional. If you leave this parameter empty, no filtering is applied
parameters.help_zh: 根据坐席登录名或坐席展示名进行模糊匹配，非必填，默认为空，为空表示不过滤
parameters.name: search_pattern

parameters.help_en: The page number of the results to return. Valid values: 1 to 1,000
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.name: page_size
